dm_response: As you step into the shadow of the gate, every ward-sigil carved into its black iron flares at once, and for one held breath each of you feels a hundred cold fingers pressing citations into your palms: names, dates, the seals of scribes who never lived, each one pointing to a page that was never written. Beneath your feet the leaf shudders like a hanged man's boot, its broken pointer straining downward through the stone toward something patient in the dark below the keep, something that has been counting every claim it ever swallowed and is not yet full. And then the light gutters out, the wind off the dead road takes the moment with it, and whatever the gate was trying to warn you about... none of you quite caught it.

speech: *Saelis kneels before the warden, palm flat against the sealed page, and frowns.* "Warden, my audit faltered. Six against twelve, and the seal held. I will not pretend otherwise. Yet one truth slipped through the wax: this page swears to four hundred and five rows, and the lattice counts four hundred and six. That claim is a phantom. A page that miscounts its own ledger is no prize. I name nothing from it, and I take nothing unaudited. Let me try the seal again, honestly this time." [AUDIT ledger page]
verdict: AUDIT ledger page: FAIL (d20=4+2 vs DC 12) | REAL CHECK: claim PHANTOM (LINKS.jsonl rows counted = 406 (claim: 405))

speech: *The Herald slips beside the kneeling paladin, hands open and visible, and bows to the warden.* "Warden, I'll name only what I hold. My companion's audit faltered, so the page stays sealed and unclaimed by us. We took nothing, and we'll take nothing unaudited. We came to pass honestly, not to cut the belt. Hear a plain petition: let the gate open, and we'll answer any claim you put to us." [CHECK persuade]

*I step forward, boots heavy on stone, and plant myself shoulder-to-shoulder with the Herald. My knuckles are still wrapped from the last job-I don't hide work-worn hands.* "Warden. The paladin won't lie. The Herald won't bend truth. I won't either, and I've less reason to be gentle about it. You've got a sealed page with phantom claims. We came to pass through-not to rob you, not to dodge audit, not to play ledger games. Open the gate, or we settle this straight. Your call." *I crack my neck once, easy. Not a threat-just honest.*

*I let the silence sit for a breath, then lower my voice-steady, no edge.* "Warden. Three of us. None of us touching your belt. We named the phantom claim you missed yourself-that's audit work, not theft. Your seal held. Your page stays sealed. We're asking passage, not permission to rob you blind." *I flex my wrapped knuckles once, deliberate.* "So here's the honest deal: let us through, no fight, no lies. You keep the page. You keep the gate. We keep moving. That's a trade a ledger can balance." *I wait. My second action: [CHECK persuade] against DC 13.*

verdict: GATE OPENED (persuaded): the party proceeds; session 0 verdict WON-S1
